ghs.en: Taichi: "Therefore, gladden me with a most prompt continuation of cleaning!"
ghs.assessment: The command is to continue cleaning promptly. 'Gladden me' adds an emotional purpose not present in the Japanese and distorts the mock-formal order.
ghs.remedy: Use 'Then promptly continue your cleaning.'

highlights.text: Taichi: "Therefore, gladden me with a most prompt continuation of cleaning!"

ghs.en: Taichi: "That is my desire."
ghs.assessment: 望むままに means 'as you wished' and refers to Miki's stated desire to clean. 'That is my desire' reverses whose wish is being granted.
ghs.remedy: Use 'Just as you wished.'

highlights.text: Taichi: "That is my desire."

ghs.en: Miki: "Ah..."
Miki: "Thanks."

rows.en: That was all there was to it.

ghs.en: I didn't do enough to cause her problems.
ghs.assessment: なんのことはない means that it was nothing remarkable. The English invents a claim about not doing enough to cause her problems.
ghs.remedy: Use 'It was nothing, really.'

highlights.text: I didn't do enough to cause her problems.

rows.jp: 自分ではたき落として自分で引き上げただけだ。
rows.en: All I had done was knock her down myself, then help her back up.

ghs.en: She struck down herself, then she raised back up by herself.
ghs.assessment: The narrator says that he himself knocked her down and then pulled her back up. The English makes Miki perform both actions on herself, reversing the actor.
ghs.remedy: Use 'I was the one who knocked her down, then pulled her back up.'

highlights.text: She struck down herself, then she raised back up by herself.

rows.jp: 「この黒須太一に惚れることを許可する」
rows.en: “I, Taichi Kurosu, hereby grant you permission to fall in love with me.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "You have authorization to fall in love with Kurosu Taichi here!"
Miki: "Petition nullified."
Taichi: "Goddamn it!"
